title: Connecting the Evidence

beats.narrativeText: Atlas assembles every recovered record, observation and experiment into a single investigation archive.
Several plausible interpretations of the evidence remain possible, but only one accounts for everything.
The learner reviews the evidence gathered throughout the entire campaign.
Organising the findings begins to reveal how individual discoveries fit together into a coherent explanation.
The learner must identify relationships between discoveries and support conclusions with evidence.
Evaluating the alternative explanations, the learner narrows the evidence down to a single account that fits everything.
The learner reflects on how many separate investigations turned out to be part of one larger story.
The complete story of Outpost Echo begins to emerge, and the learner prepares to solve the expedition mystery.

activities.title: Review Evidence
activities.storyContext: Atlas has assembled every recovered record, observation and experiment into a single investigation archive.
activities.instructions: Review the evidence gathered throughout the campaign so far.

activities.title: Organise Findings
activities.storyContext: Individual discoveries may fit together into a coherent explanation.
activities.instructions: Organise your findings into related groups.

activities.title: Identify Relationships
activities.storyContext: Discoveries that once seemed unrelated may actually be connected.
activities.instructions: Identify relationships between your organised groups of evidence.
activities.output: A description of the relationships between findings.

activities.title: Support Conclusions With Evidence
activities.storyContext: Only one explanation accounts for all of the available evidence.
activities.instructions: Write a conclusion supported by the evidence you have connected.

activities.title: Evaluate Alternative Explanations
activities.storyContext: Several plausible interpretations of the evidence remain possible.
activities.instructions: Evaluate a couple of alternative explanations and explain why your conclusion fits the evidence best.

activities.title: Produce an Investigation Board
activities.storyContext: A visual investigation board would help show how all the clues connect.
activities.instructions: Produce an investigation board linking the clues you've gathered visually.

activities.title: How Evidence-Based Explanations Are Built
activities.storyContext: Connecting scattered evidence into one explanation is exactly what detectives and scientists do.
activities.instructions: Find out how detectives, archaeologists and scientists build evidence-based explanations.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: Which piece of evidence changed your understanding of the mystery the most?

discussionPoints: Which piece of evidence changed your thinking the most?
Why is it useful to consider more than one explanation before deciding?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a conclusion that accounts for the full range of evidence, not just the most memorable pieces.

completionCriteria: Evidence reviewed, findings organised, and conclusions supported with evidence.
